spans.s:
√spṛ 'win'
present: [5.] spṛṇoti spṛṇute etc. spṛṇvaté -- [9.] spṛṇāti 
perfect: paspāra 
aorist: [1.] aspar etc. spárat spṛdhi etc. -- [4.] áspārṣam 
[future: spariṣyati spartā ]
verbal: spṛtá spṛtvā́ spárase 
derivatives: spara spáraṇa AV.B. spṛ́t V.B. spṛ́ti B.S. -spartṛ RV.

√spṛdh 'contend'
present: [1.] spárdhate etc. V.+ spárdhati etc. E.+ -- [6.] spūrdhán 
perfect: paspṛdhé etc. ápaspṛdhethām paspardha E.+ 
aorist: [1.] aspṛdhran spṛdhāná -- [5.] aspardhiṣṭa 
[future: spardhiṣyate spardhitā ]
verbal: spardhita E.+ spárdhitum -spṛ́dhya spūrdháse 
[secondary: pāspṛdh- pispardhiṣa- spardhaya- ]
derivatives: spṛ́dh spardhā B.+ spardhin E.+ spardhya E. spardhanīya C. -spardhas V.+

√spṛś 'touch'
present: [6.] spṛśati etc. V.+ spṛśate etc. AV.+ spṛśāna -- [1.] asparśat 
perfect: paspṛśus paspṛśe E.+ pasparśus? paspárśat 
aorist: [1.] spṛśyāt -- [3.] pisṛśas pisṛśati -- [4.] asprākṣam etc. aspārkṣīt -- [7.] áspṛkṣat etc. 
future: [1.] sprakṣyati etc. sparkṣyati -- [2.] spraṣṭā sparṣṭā 
verbal: spṛṣṭá AV.+ spraṣṭum E.+ spṛṣṭvā B.+ -spṛ́śya B.+ -spṛ́śe -spṛ́śas 
secondary: passive: spṛśyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: parīspṛś- -- desiderative: pispṛkṣa- -- causative: sparśayati etc. B.+ sparśayate 
derivatives: -spṛś V.+ -spṛśa E.+ spṛśya E.+ sparśa AV.+ sparśin S.+ sparśana U.S.+ sparśanīya E.+ spṛśi C. spṛ́ṣṭi B.+ spraṣṭavyà B.+ spraṣṭṛ́ B.+ sparśitṛ E. pispṛkṣu E.+ sparśayitavya U. 
Compare √pṛś, pṛṣ; a part of the words there given may with considerable plausibility be connected with this root.

√spṛh 'be eager'
present: [6.] spṛhantī 
secondary: causative: spṛhayati etc. V.+ spṛhayate etc. E.+ 
derivatives: -spṛh spṛhā E.+ spārhá V.+ spṛhaṇa E. spṛhaṇīya E.+ spṛhayālu E.+ spṛhayā́yya RV. 
The non-causative form only in āp. dh. ś. 1. 31. 9 (perhaps an error?).
